_comment: Tool floors for sim/. 'floor' is the minimum this repo claims; 'verified_with' is what the smoke record was actually produced with. setup-env.sh does not install host tools -- a tool below its floor is reported, not fixed.

ngspice.needs: KLU solver; OSDI 0.4 (ngspice >= 44) for any MOS/PSP103 deck. npn13G2 alone (native VBIC) runs on 42.

openvaf.libllvm: libLLVM.so.21 from the apt.llvm.org libllvm21 .deb, sha256-pinned in sim/tools/build-osdi.sh (Linux x86_64 only)

klt.used_by: sim/smoke/run_smoke.sh (klt sim corner requests with options.osdi_preload, options.stage_model_inputs)
klt.not_usable: 0.7.1.dev1755+gdce956c3c399 (the host-installed build): batch jobs failed on the worker with exit 2 and no report on 2026-10-17 for these requests; 0.7.0 ran them
